source.label: Synthetic fixture: reviewed weekly adoption summary
source.sql: SELECT reporting_week AS week, segment, region, active_users AS activeUsers, target_users AS targetUsers, growth, conversion FROM analytics.product_adoption_summary

metricDefinitions.label: Active users
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct accounts active during the reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Target users
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed operating target for active accounts during the reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Weekly growth
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed change in active accounts versus the preceding reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Conversion
metricDefinitions.definition: Activated accounts divided by qualified sign-ups.

metricDefinitions.label: Modeled active users
metricDefinitions.definition: Illustrative projection applying selected activation and retention lifts to reviewed active users; not a reviewed source value.

source.label: Synthetic fixture: account activation journey
filters: Accounts signing up during the reporting week; stage completion observed as of 2026-07-28. The newest cohort is incomplete.
assumptions: Invented, mutually exclusive product/region cohorts. All-scope counts are the sum of the three slices. No live query was executed.
This is a sign-up cohort funnel, not the weekly flow of activations in the acquisition-channel chart.

metricDefinitions.label: Accounts at stage
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct accounts from the same sign-up cohort reaching each ordered stage: sign-up, workspace creation, first key action, activation. Later stages are subsets of earlier stages.

metricDefinitions.label: Step conversion
metricDefinitions.definition: Accounts at the current stage divided by accounts at the previous stage. Missing or zero previous-stage denominators are undefined.

metricDefinitions.label: Share of sign-ups
metricDefinitions.definition: Accounts at the current stage divided by all sign-ups in the selected cohort. Counts are not summed across stages.

source.label: Synthetic fixture: reviewed segment performance
source.sql: SELECT reporting_week AS week, segment, region, active_users AS activeUsers, target_users AS targetUsers, qualified, previous_users AS previousUsers, net_change AS netChange, retention_rate AS retention, projected_users AS projectedUsers, at_risk_users AS atRiskUsers, risk_score AS riskScore, risk_tier AS riskTier FROM analytics.segment_performance WHERE reporting_week = DATE '2026-07-27'

metricDefinitions.label: Active users
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed active accounts attributed to the selected product segment.

metricDefinitions.label: Net change
metricDefinitions.definition: Current active users minus active users in the preceding reviewed week.

metricDefinitions.label: Retention
metricDefinitions.definition: Share of previously active accounts retained in the reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: At-risk users
metricDefinitions.definition: Active accounts with synthetic fixture signals indicating elevated renewal or engagement risk.

source.label: Synthetic fixture: reviewed weekly growth bridge
source.sql: SELECT reporting_week AS week, segment, region, bridge_step AS driver, bridge_value AS change FROM analytics.product_growth_drivers WHERE reporting_week IN (DATE '2026-07-20', DATE '2026-07-27') ORDER BY reporting_week, segment, bridge_order

metricDefinitions.label: Driver contribution
metricDefinitions.definition: Signed active-account movement attributed to activation, expansion, or churn.

metricDefinitions.label: Before and after
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed active-account totals before and after the signed driver contributions.

metricDefinitions.label: Net growth
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of driver contributions, excluding the before and after totals.
metricDefinitions.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN driver NOT IN ('Before', 'After') THEN change ELSE 0 END)

source.label: Synthetic fixture: reviewed adoption forecast outlook
source.sql: SELECT reporting_week AS week, segment, region, actual_users AS actualUsers, target_users AS targetUsers, projected_users AS projectedUsers, forecast_gap AS forecastGap, at_risk_users AS atRiskUsers, forecast_confidence AS confidence, risk_tier AS riskTier FROM analytics.product_adoption_forecast WHERE reporting_week IN (DATE '2026-07-20', DATE '2026-07-27')

metricDefinitions.label: Actual users
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed active accounts for the current reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Projected users
metricDefinitions.definition: Synthetic reviewed forecast of active accounts in the next reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Target users
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed active-account operating target for the reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Forecast gap
metricDefinitions.definition: Projected active accounts minus the reporting-week target.

metricDefinitions.label: At-risk users
metricDefinitions.definition: Active accounts with synthetic fixture signals indicating elevated renewal or engagement risk.

metricDefinitions.label: Confidence
metricDefinitions.definition: Synthetic modeled confidence in the reviewed adoption forecast, expressed from zero to one.

source.label: Synthetic fixture: reviewed account health snapshots
source.sql: SELECT reporting_week AS week, segment, region, account_name AS account, active_users AS activeUsers, previous_users AS previousUsers, retention_rate AS retention, engagement_score AS engagementScore, at_risk_users AS atRiskUsers, risk_score AS riskScore, risk_tier AS riskTier, next_action AS nextAction FROM analytics.account_health_fixture WHERE reporting_week IN (DATE '2026-07-20', DATE '2026-07-27')
filters: All account names are invented synthetic examples

metricDefinitions.label: Active users
metricDefinitions.definition: Synthetic active accounts attributed to the named account; accounts reconcile to reviewed segment totals.

metricDefinitions.label: Previous users
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed active accounts for the same account during the preceding reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Net change
metricDefinitions.definition: Current active users minus previous active users for the same reviewed account.

metricDefinitions.label: Retention
metricDefinitions.definition: Synthetic share of an account's previously active users retained during the reporting week.

metricDefinitions.label: Engagement score
metricDefinitions.definition: Synthetic account engagement indicator on a zero-to-100 scale.

metricDefinitions.label: At-risk users
metricDefinitions.definition: Active accounts with synthetic fixture signals indicating elevated renewal or engagement risk.

metricDefinitions.label: Risk score
metricDefinitions.definition: Synthetic account renewal and engagement risk on a zero-to-100 scale, where higher means more risk.

metricDefinitions.label: Risk tier
metricDefinitions.definition: Reviewed categorical risk classification; its source does not disclose numeric thresholds.
